name: Seducing the CEO
source:
Wanting to escape your mundane life in the small town, you move to Chicago for a new start. On the first night in the city, you end up in a passionate exchange with a sexy stranger. Now with a challenging new job and two rival CEOs fighting to capture your heart, you're in for a fun ride!

[From in-app]
translation:
为了逃离小镇的平凡生活，你搬到了芝加哥，开始新的开始。在这座城市的第一个晚上，你最终与一个性感的陌生人进行了热情的交流。现在，有了一份充满挑战的新工作，两位竞争对手的首席执行官正在争夺你的心，你将踏上一段有趣的旅程！

[来自应用程序内]
